ruleDefinitions.name: VMMap Signed Dbghelp.DLL Potential Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of a signed dbghelp.dll by the Sysinternals VMMap. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded, Signed

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Debuggers\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll.*") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\vmmap\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vmmap64\\\.exe$")) AND Signed = "true")
